definitions.explanation: A systematic list of items, books, artworks, or other objects, often compiled for reference or record-keeping purposes.
A formal list presented in place of actual gifts at ceremonial occasions, indicating what gifts will be delivered later. Traditional practice in Japanese gift-giving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書|としょ}→図書：03459_tosho⟧{目録|もくろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{所蔵品|しょぞうひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目録|もくろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The museum compiled a catalog of its collection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寄贈|きぞう}→寄贈：12345_kizou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{書籍|しょせき}→書籍：04203_shoseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目録|もくろく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A catalog of the donated books has been made public.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目録|もくろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: For our wedding we were presented with a gift list, the gift itself to follow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賞品|しょうひん}→賞品：21558_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{目録|もくろく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{贈呈|ぞうてい}→贈呈：16752_zoutei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The prizes were presented as a list, to be delivered later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{目録|もくろく}にして{後日届|ごじつとど}けて⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The large appliances were presented as a list and delivered at a later date.

notes:
USAGE (Sense 1):
Used in libraries, museums and archives.
- ⟦{蔵書|ぞうしょ}→蔵書：15479_zousho⟧{目録|もくろく}: library catalog
- ⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧{目録|もくろく}: exhibition catalog
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧{目録|もくろく}: product catalog

USAGE (Sense 2):
A decorative sheet listing gifts or prizes, handed over at a ceremony in place of the items themselves, which are delivered later. Seen at weddings and award ceremonies, and on TV quiz shows when a winner is handed the {目録|もくろく} of their prizes.

ETYMOLOGY:
{目|もく} (item) + {録|ろく} (record).

REGISTER:
Formal. For an everyday list, ⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧ or ⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧ is more common.
